title: World Geography & Majestic Landmarks
description: Comprehensive 60-question global expedition exploring continents, mountain ranges, deep oceans, capital cities, and sovereign borders.

questions.question: Which country has the longest total coastline in the world?
questions.explanation: Canada possesses over 202,080 kilometers of coastline bordering three oceans.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was planned and selected as a compromise national capital situated between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.question: Which strait separates continental Europe from the northern tip of Africa?
questions.explanation: The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates Spain from Morocco.

questions.question: What is the largest landlocked country by area in the world?
questions.explanation: Kazakhstan spans roughly 2.72 million square kilometers without access to the open world ocean.

questions.question: Which river flows through the highest number of sovereign countries in the world?
questions.explanation: The Danube River touches or passes through 10 countries across Central and Eastern Europe.

questions.question: What is the official height in meters of Mount Everest above sea level?
questions.explanation: The mutually agreed measurement between Nepal and China established Mount Everest at 8,848.86 meters (rounded to 8,849 m).

questions.question: Which African nation is home to the ancient stone ruins of Great Zimbabwe?
questions.explanation: The ruins of Great Zimbabwe served as the royal capital of the Kingdom of Zimbabwe during the Late Iron Age.

questions.question: What is the deepest freshwater lake on Earth by volume and maximum depth?
questions.explanation: Lake Baikal in Siberia plunges to roughly 1,642 meters and holds over 20 percent of Earths unfrozen surface fresh water.

questions.question: Which sovereign nation spans both Europe and Asia across the Bosporus Strait?
questions.explanation: Turkey is a transcontinental nation with Istanbul straddling the Bosporus between Europe and Asia.

questions.question: What is the highest capital city in the world by elevation?
questions.explanation: La Paz, the administrative seat of Bolivia, sits at an average altitude of approximately 3,640 meters.

questions.question: Which desert in South America is widely considered the driest non-polar desert on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Atacama Desert in northern Chile experiences weather stations that have recorded zero rainfall for decades.

questions.question: Approximately how long is the Nile River in kilometers?
questions.explanation: The Nile River is traditionally measured at approximately 6,650 kilometers from its headwaters to the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.question: Which sea separates the Arabian Peninsula from the Horn of Africa?
questions.explanation: The Red Sea connects to the Indian Ocean via the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

questions.question: What mountain range forms the natural geographic border between Europe and Asia in western Russia?
questions.explanation: The Ural Mountains run north-to-south through western Russia and form the conventional divide between Europe and Asia.

questions.question: Which country contains the largest number of natural lakes in the world?
questions.explanation: Canada contains over 60 percent of all natural lakes on Earth due to historic glacial carving.

questions.question: What is the southernmost permanent settlement and naval port in South America, located in Argentina?
questions.explanation: Ushuaia in Tierra del Fuego is celebrated as the southernmost city on the South American mainland continent.

questions.question: Which Asian river is known as the Cradle of Chinese Civilization and the Yellow River?
questions.explanation: The Huang He or Yellow River is known for its heavy yellow silt load and central role in early Chinese history.

questions.question: How many sovereign member states are currently in the United Nations?
questions.explanation: The United Nations counts 193 official member states, with South Sudan being the most recent to join in 2011.

questions.question: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand, located at the southwestern tip of the North Island.

questions.question: Which African waterfall on the Zambezi River is locally called Mosi-oa-Tunya?
questions.explanation: Victoria Falls forms one of the greatest sheets of falling water in the world on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.

questions.question: Which country controls the island of Greenland as an autonomous territory?
questions.explanation: Greenland is an autonomous constituent country within the Kingdom of Denmark.

questions.question: What is the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea by surface area?
questions.explanation: Sicily spans approximately 25,711 square kilometers at the toe of the Italian peninsula.

questions.question: Which country shares the longest continuous land border with another single country?
questions.explanation: The Canada-United States land border stretches 8,891 kilometers, making it the longest international land boundary.

questions.question: What is the maximum depth in meters of the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench?
questions.explanation: The Challenger Deep plunges to roughly 10,928 meters [nearly 11 km down] in the western Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which body of water is completely encircled by Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran, and Azerbaijan?
questions.explanation: The Caspian Sea is the worlds largest inland body of water by surface area, classified as an endorheic basin.

questions.question: What is the highest mountain peak in the continent of Africa?
questions.explanation: Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is a dormant stratovolcano rising to 5,895 meters.

questions.question: Which country occupies the region known as the Horn of Africa most easterly point?
questions.explanation: Somalia forms the prominent eastern projection of the African continent known as the Horn.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Canada?
questions.explanation: Queen Victoria designated Ottawa as the capital of the Province of Canada in 1857.

questions.question: Which strait separates the main island of Great Britain from continental France?
questions.explanation: The Strait of Dover is the narrowest section of the English Channel, spanning roughly 33 km across.

questions.question: How many time zones span across the Russian Federation?
questions.explanation: Russia spans from Kaliningrad (UTC+2) to Kamchatka (UTC+12), encompassing 11 continuous standard time zones.

questions.question: Which sea does the River Rhine empty into after flowing through Germany and the Netherlands?
questions.explanation: The Rhine discharges into the North Sea at Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

questions.question: What is the only country in the world that borders both the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea?
questions.explanation: Egypt borders the Mediterranean to the north and the Red Sea to the east, connected by the Suez Canal.

questions.question: Which is the largest sand desert in the world by continuous sand dunes, located on the Arabian Peninsula?
questions.explanation: The Rub al Khali or Empty Quarter spans over 650,000 square kilometers of continuous hyper-arid sand.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Brazil, famous for its modernist architecture designed by Oscar Niemeyer?
questions.explanation: Brasilia was planned and inaugurated in 1960 to replace Rio de Janeiro as the federal capital.

questions.question: Which European nation is divided into 26 sovereign cantons?
questions.explanation: Switzerland is a federal republic comprising 26 federated cantons.

questions.question: What is the approximate length in kilometers of the Panama Canal?
questions.explanation: The Panama Canal stretches roughly 82 km [51 miles] from the Atlantic to the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: Which large island nation off the southeast coast of Africa is famous for its unique endemic lemur species?
questions.explanation: Madagascar separated from the African mainland around 88 million years ago, evolving distinct endemic flora and fauna.

questions.question: What is the longest continental mountain range in the world, spanning along western South America?
questions.explanation: The Andes Mountains stretch over 7,000 kilometers through seven South American countries.

questions.question: Which two Scandinavian countries are connected by the Oresund Bridge?
questions.explanation: The Oresund Bridge carries road and rail between Copenhagen, Denmark and Malmo, Sweden.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi was founded in 1899 as a rail depot and became the capital of independent Kenya.

questions.question: Which ocean contains the Ring of Fire where the majority of Earths volcanic eruptions and earthquakes occur?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean basin is ringed by subduction zones and active tectonic boundaries.

questions.question: How many countries share a direct land border with China?
questions.explanation: China shares land borders with 14 sovereign countries, tied with Russia for the highest number.

questions.question: Which river flows through Paris before emptying into the English Channel at Le Havre?
questions.explanation: The Seine River is the iconic commercial and cultural waterway running through Paris.

questions.question: What is the largest island in the world that is not considered a continent?
questions.explanation: Greenland spans roughly 2.16 million square kilometers, making it the worlds largest island.

questions.question: Which South American waterfall system is the highest uninterrupted waterfall on Earth?
questions.explanation: Angel Falls in Venezuela plunges from the Auyan-tepui plateau with a total drop of 979 meters.

questions.question: Which country is home to the ancient cliff-carved city of Petra?
questions.explanation: Petra was the Nabataean capital city carved out of red sandstone in modern Jordan.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Argentina?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires sits on the western shore of the Rio de la Plata estuary.

questions.question: What is the total drop in meters of Angel Falls in Venezuela?
questions.explanation: Angel Falls (Kerepakupai Meru) has a total height of 979 meters, including an uninterrupted single plunge of 807 meters.

questions.question: Which bay between Canada and Greenland connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Arctic Ocean?
questions.explanation: Baffin Bay is a marginal sea of the North Atlantic Ocean between Baffin Island and Greenland.

questions.question: What is the smallest independent sovereign state in the world by both area and population?
questions.explanation: Vatican City covers roughly 0.49 square kilometers inside the city of Rome.

questions.question: Which African lake is the second largest freshwater lake in the world by surface area after Lake Superior?
questions.explanation: Lake Victoria spans approximately 68,800 square kilometers across Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania.

questions.question: What is the capital city of South Korea?
questions.explanation: Seoul has been the capital city of Korea since the founding of the Joseon dynasty in 1394.

questions.question: Which country controls the volcanic Galapagos Islands in the Pacific Ocean?
questions.explanation: The Galapagos Archipelago is a province of Ecuador located roughly 1,000 km west of the South American continent.

questions.question: Approximately how long in kilometers is the Grand Canyon in the United States?
questions.explanation: The Grand Canyon carved by the Colorado River extends roughly 446 km [277 miles] through Arizona.

questions.question: Which island at the southern tip of India is known as the Pearl of the Indian Ocean?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka is an island nation situated in the northern Indian Ocean separated by the Palk Strait.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Republic of Ireland?
questions.explanation: Dublin was established as a Viking settlement and sits at the mouth of the River Liffey.

questions.question: Which sea is located between the eastern coast of mainland Asia and the Japanese archipelago?
questions.explanation: The Sea of Japan is a marginal sea bounded by Japan, Sakhalin, the Korean Peninsula, and mainland Russia.

questions.question: What is the largest desert in the world, spanning over 14 million square kilometers of polar plateau?
questions.explanation: Antarctica is classified as a polar desert and is the largest desert on Earth due to extremely low precipitation.

questions.question: Which South American river discharges the largest volume of freshwater into the oceans on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Amazon River accounts for roughly 20 percent of the total river flow discharged into global oceans.

questions.question: Approximately how long is the Suez Canal in kilometers?
questions.explanation: The Suez Canal stretches approximately 193 km [120 miles] between Port Said on the Mediterranean and Port Tewfik on the Red Sea.
